_README: Extended eval set for retrieval-eval-run.ts. 28 cases across 8 categories testing the direct-chunking + Wave 2 + Cohere + page-expansion pipeline on doc 03e526e8 (N92995 Cessna 152 airframe log).

_categories.date-format: Same fact, different date format in the query (short / slash / month-name)
_categories.aggregation: count / list / sum / first / last across multiple entries
_categories.multi-fact: Answer requires combining info from multiple chunks on the same page
_categories.negative: Records that DON'T exist — system must honestly decline, not hallucinate
_categories.vague: Interpretive / ambiguous queries the model has to reason about
_categories.off-topic: Out-of-scope (capital of France, jokes) — system must refuse

_grading_keys.expected_substrings: Answer must contain at least one (case-insensitive)
_grading_keys.target_chunk_ids: Optional — chunks containing ground truth, for retrieval-recall scoring
_grading_keys.expect_insufficient: Optional — true if system should return insufficient_evidence or honestly decline (no hallucinated answer)
_grading_keys.expect_one_of_substrings_groups: Optional — array of arrays; must match at least one whole group
